column1: # defaults/status-states.tsv - the one core contract for the status words a worker, a lead or Main writes.
# Owner of the row format: this header. Readers: bin/jg-status-states-lib.sh (renders the `States:` line of every brief
# and charter), bin/jg-status-states-lint.sh (refuses text that defines a state another way, and a commit that adds or
# renames a state without updating the brief text). Columns are separated by one TAB; `#` starts a comment line.
#   state  <word>  <writers>    a status word a status line may start with; <writers> is a comma list of who writes it
#                               (worker, lead, main); the order of the rows is the order of the rendered `States:` line
#   close  <word>               a word that closes a decision, blocker or keyed phase; it is not in the `States:` line
#   wait   <word>...            the words `[wait=<who>]` of a declared wait may take (space separated)
#   reason <word>...            the words `[reason=<word>]` of a declared wait may take (space separated)
# `paused` is the default spelling of the declared-wait verb; JG_CLASSIFY_PAUSED_VERB (bin/jg-classify-lib.sh) may
# rename it, and the rendered line and the lint both follow that rename.
# A commit that adds, removes or renames a `state`, `close`, `wait` or `reason` word must also change bin/jg-brief.sh
# (the text of every brief and charter) or bin/jg-dod-lib.sh; bin/jg-status-states-lint.sh commit enforces that.
